provider: Current Google Maps satellite layer, directly viewed in the browser; imagery credits Airbus, Maxar Technologies and Vexcel Imaging US
imagery_acquisition_date: Not exposed in the inspected interface. Copyright 2026 is not a verified capture date. This is the current accessible default mosaic, not a guarantee of the newest possible imagery worldwide.
scope: The complete existing modeled campus, with five district sweeps and enlarged checks of suspected roof-material discrepancies; 177 indexed building layers. This is a regional plan/roof review, not individual facade or measured-condition certification.

north.name: Northern housing, athletics, art and library district
observations: Three pale Campus North residential roof bars around open courts, with a distinct olive lower dining roof to their west
Max Palevsky roofs show a blue-violet surface; Henry Crown shows a brown-red pitched roof
Ratner pale metal curved roofs, track and baseball field arrangement, Regenstein stepped plan and Mansueto oval dome remain identifiable

quads.name: Main Quadrangles, Hull Court and Science Quadrangle
observations: Red pitched wing roofs dominate the historic quadrangles, with localized flat modern laboratory roofs
Central lawn circle and approach axes, enclosing courtyard voids and Hull Court building relationships are retained
Targeted enlarged Hutchinson image resolves its long red gabled hall roof, Reynolds wing and multiple cross-gables on the Hull laboratories

medical.name: Western clinical and research district
observations: Clinical blocks have mixed pale/gray flat membranes and dense roof plant, distinct from historic red-roof laboratory ranges
Major hospital mass offsets, courtyard voids and raised connectors remain visible
Construction and paved surfaces beyond the existing mapped scope are not assumed to be completed university buildings

south.name: Midway, Law Quadrangle and south-campus residences/institutions
observations: Midway lawns are divided by road corridors, tree belts and existing paths; the rink occupies its mapped central location
Law and residential blocks retain their mapped open courts and separate flat/steep roof ranges
Woodlawn, Grossman, Logan, Keller, Rubenstein and southern institutional footprints were compared at district-plan scale

east.name: Eastern academic corridor, Laboratory Schools and International House
observations: Roof plans combine red historic wings, flat contemporary additions and green court/athletics spaces
Rockefeller, Robie, Booth, school courts, Jackman field and International House remain distinct plan elements
Enlarged Ida Noyes view confirms red roof wings, dormer rhythm and a contemporary flat roof to the north

specific_corrections.U002: Replace universally green residential tower caps with pale gray-white membranes; separate the western low planted dining roof and trace tower/roof partitions against the mapped outline.
specific_corrections.U006: Change the Henry Crown pitched roof to a bounded brown-red material.
specific_corrections.U011: Correct Max Palevsky roof palette from brown to blue-violet.
specific_corrections.U014: Correct Max Palevsky roof palette from brown to blue-violet.
specific_corrections.U018: Correct Max Palevsky roof palette from brown to blue-violet.
specific_corrections.U034: Refine the observed repeated two-sided cross-gable roof rhythm in the detailed Zoology reconstruction.
specific_corrections.U036: Refine the northern Hull range roof/gable rhythm in the detailed Anatomy reconstruction.
specific_corrections.U050: Refine the longitudinal Hull laboratory cross-gable rhythm in the detailed Erman reconstruction.
specific_corrections.U051: Refine the higher western Hull range gables in the detailed Culver reconstruction.

limitations: Tree cover and roof shadows obscure secondary footprints and some courtyard edges. Roof color is interpreted as a material class, not a calibrated color sample.

Satellite viewing does not verify entrance elevations, actual floor heights, interiors, facade carving or every small mechanical unit. Street-level/owner/architect photographs supplement the detailed Main Quad reconstruction.
No source imagery is redistributed; the audit stores source links and observations only.
The model is still an exterior interpretation. A district sweep is not evidence that every historical Highlight already satisfies the detailed modeling standard.
